title: BuildSettings
description: Data file content/build/settings.json: how the core asks for a building plan for an approved invention, checks it (B4b R14) and lets the inventor build it step by step (D471 D5, stages 4, 5, 7). Values are placeholders until Marcel decides.

retry_after_minutes.description: Game minutes until a plan is asked for again after an error or a refused plan.

help_after_hours.description: Game hours the builder goes on looking by itself while no material of the current step is in sight (only hours in which it is free count - not asleep, eating or busy); then it needs help (event needs_help with the missing material's properties, R15). Omitted = it never asks.

give_up_after_hours.description: Game hours of looking without any material of the current step in sight (counted like help_after_hours) after which the builder gives up the building (event build_failed, detail no_material; loop brake R17). Omitted = it waits without a limit, as before.

max_plan_attempts.description: Most plans asked for one invention; after that it stays unbuilt.

bounds_tolerance.description: How much larger than the invention's size the box around all parts may be (factor per axis).

step_action.description: Action (vocabulary, with timing and effects in content/effects) by which the builder uses up one material object for a step.

use_action.description: Action (vocabulary) by which inhabitants use a made thing; its first use of an invention becomes the event first_use.

min_need_to_build.description: The inventor only builds while every need that can be neglected is at least this high.

sound_max_attempts.description: Most sound jobs for one built invention; a retryable failure is tried again in the next compute night, after the last attempt the invention keeps no sound of its own (base library by description).

BuildQuality.description: D827 R19 (A1376): every built thing carries a quality tier from the builder's skill when it is finished - the highest tier whose from_level the skill reaches (tiers in ascending from_level, the first from 0). Text keys ui.build.quality.<id> (DE/EN). Omitted = no quality.

skill.description: The skill that decides the quality (vocabulary skill).

from_level.description: Skill level from which this tier is reached.

BuildEscalation.description: A1373 step 2 (D827 R15/R17c, D850, B2658): when the help does not come, the builder asks the decider what to do, with options only the core offers: take a thing it believes has the missing properties instead, finish smaller (leave the thing as far as it is built), give up. First after_hours of looking after needs_help, then every after_hours again, at most max times per building. Omitted = the builder never asks, as before.

after_hours.description: Game hours of looking (counted like help_after_hours) from needs_help to the first question, and between two questions.

max.description: Most questions per building (loop brake R17c).

use_instead_action.description: Action of the option 'take this thing instead' (target: a thing in sight).

smaller_action.description: Action of the option 'finish smaller' (no target; offered once a step is done).

give_up_action.description: Action of the option 'give up' (no target; always offered).

help_action.description: Action of the option 'ask another for help' (target: an inhabitant; comes with the next step, not offered yet). Like the others never an invention's purpose.

max_use_instead.description: Most 'take this instead' options in one question (nearest kinds first). Omitted = 2.

help_affection_per_step.description: A1376 (D827 R19, B2663): how much the affection of builder and helper for each other grows with every material the helper works in. Omitted = 0.
